findings.summary: Regex coercion omits explicit scalar string checks for commit/digest request fields and observed owner UUIDs.
findings.reproduction: With otherwise valid JSON data, reviewed_commit:[fullCommit] or receipt_raw_sha256:[fullDigest] passes initial validation, performs all four reads, retains the array and returns identity_revision_observed without diagnostics. A profile user_id:[ownerUUID] also passes recorder identity validation and returns the matching state with normal downstream responses. Both observed owner arrays pass identity checks individually; when reviewer/current authors have separately parsed arrays, strict reference comparison eventually produces decision_author_mismatch.
findings.impact: Violates exact request validation before reads, issues unnecessary reads for invalid requests and mislabels malformed identity observations as matching. Array commit/digest or reviewer_owner_id captures fail strict journal validation. This is a bounded validation/observation defect, not proof of receipt authentication or authority escalation.
findings.requested_change: Require typeof value === string before each commit/digest/observed owner regex check. Invalid requests must reject before any adapter call; malformed recorder/reviewer owners must stay pending and stop after one/two reads respectively. Add regression fixtures using JSON-serializable single-element arrays and verify normal string inputs still interoperate with strict journal. Fresh exact source review required.

valid packet strict capture_metadata interoperability with fixed unverified/pending/unchecked metadata
extra fields, boolean/unsafe revisions, uppercase UUID and trailing LF hash rejected before reads
recorder identity, reviewer kind, current owner/author and post mismatch dependent-read stopping
changed revision, unexpected current/pinned editor, and changed pinned text diagnostics

limits: Host-supplied adapter is caller-controlled; synthetic/imported packets can forge equivalent responses. No signatures, host attestation or independent authenticated decision evidence established.
No live collection or raw connector response publication; no credentials, subscription/poll/ack consumer, outbox intake, shared implementation edits or deployed API/database access.
identity_revision_observed is observational only, inter-read races possible. Immutable snapshotting of a mutating host request/adapter is not audited.
Full schema/duplicate-key and canonical-size validation is explicitly deferred to journal import; response cap is UTF-16 code units, not UTF-8 bytes.
No exhaustive malicious-adapter/proxy/getter/resource/time/memory/race/crash audit. No transport timeout guarantee.
Journal checks here use capture_metadata with original synthetic receipt bytes; journal storage/concurrency behavior covered historically and by current full Python suite, not a new live acquisition.

Initial reviewer extraction included nonexistent schemas path and was corrected before test reruns. An initial Node-to-Python synchronous probe harness stalled and was canceled; final public harness uses Python to run Node and then journal checks. These setup/harness failures are not implementation findings.

disposition.market_completion: deliver review only; recipient assessment separate
